build.evidence_boundary: Current indexed static snapshot; no game, Java, or Lua execution.

prior_evidence.policy: The existing UniversalTraits:UT_alcoholic_I row was retained and checked against current exact source anchors. Correct proofs are preserved below; canned, overbroad, or contradicted claims are refined explicitly.

findings.problem: The trait tests substitute UTCore.hasTrait with player:getTraits():contains(string). The production helper instead requires instanceof(player, IsoGameCharacter), ResourceLocation.of(traitId), CharacterTrait.get(...), and player:hasTrait(CharacterTrait). The focused tests therefore cannot reject a broken registry lookup, wrong receiver type, or string-vs-CharacterTrait call.
findings.exact_missing_validation: A strict focused fixture must execute the production UTCore.hasTrait path and fail if player:hasTrait receives the string ID, if ResourceLocation/CharacterTrait lookup is bypassed, or if the receiver is not an IsoGameCharacter.

findings.problem: Existing tests prove only that stress eventually rises within nine callbacks while sober and remains unchanged at intoxication 10. They do not prove exact callbacks 1/2/3, exact +0.05, threshold 5, clamp at 1, no-trait early return, persisted counter recreation, or duplicate registration behavior.
findings.exact_missing_validation: Focused assertions for tick 1 unchanged, tick 2 unchanged, tick 3 exactly +0.05 and counter=3; INTOXICATION exactly 5 unchanged; STRESS .99 clamps to 1; absent trait creates no counter; recreated player with saved counter=2 fires on the next callback; a full-relaunch trace confirms exactly one registered handler.

findings.problem: Source, release-root, and 42.0 mod.info are byte-identical and each declares poster=poster.png, but poster.png is absent at all three corresponding package levels.
findings.exact_missing_validation: After an authorized product fix, verify a real poster.png exists at source, release root, and release/UniversalTraits/42.0 and that all three copies are byte-identical.

dimensions.proof: registries.lua line 266 registers exactly CharacterTrait.register("UniversalTraits:UT_alcoholic_I").
dimensions.positive_path: The full namespaced ID resolves through the registered CharacterTrait object used by the definition and production helper.
dimensions.negative_path: A missing registration or spelling/case drift makes CharacterTrait.get(ResourceLocation.of(...)) return nil and production UTCore.hasTrait false.

dimensions.proof: The exact block supplies IsProfessionTrait=false, DisabledInMultiplayer=true, CharacterTrait=UniversalTraits:UT_alcoholic_I, Cost=-4, UIName, UIDescription, and exclusions II/III. CharacterTraitDefinitionScript.Load parses the first block, resolves CharacterTrait and exclusions through the registry, assigns the scalar fields, and publishes them through addCharacterTraitDefinition/addMutuallyExclusive.
dimensions.positive_path: Parse the exact 1874-1883 block and assert registered identity, cost -4, both UI keys, no XP/grants, multiplayer restriction metadata, and forward exclusions II/III.
dimensions.negative_path: Missing/unregistered CharacterTrait or exclusion IDs produce nil registry results; an unknown key logs a script error and throws in debug mode. Such a block must not be credited as valid.
dimensions.exact_missing_validation: No current in-game ScriptManager load/log proves this exact block loads without warnings.

dimensions.proof: Registration, script CharacterTrait, Lua TRAIT_ID, and UI keys consistently use the alcoholic_I identity and expected case.
dimensions.positive_path: All four owned surfaces join on UniversalTraits:UT_alcoholic_I and UI_UT_alcoholic_I/UI_UT_alcoholic_IDesc.
dimensions.negative_path: Any namespace or case drift breaks registry lookup, definition linkage, runtime ownership, or translated copy lookup.

dimensions.proof: Cost=-4; XPBoosts and GrantedTraits are absent; the owned block excludes II and III. The accepted prior closed-world ledger proved both referenced definitions exist and reverse declarations are reciprocal; that cross-trait evidence is reused without rereading those traits.
dimensions.positive_path: Selecting I exposes a -4-point negative trait and prevents selection with II or III in either order according to the retained reciprocal proof.
dimensions.negative_path: UT_MET membership alone is not parser enforcement; removing a script-side reverse declaration would lose bidirectional character-creation behavior.

dimensions.proof: The header says mild craving at about 30 in-game minutes; English copy says intoxication below 5 and +0.05 stress every 30 minutes; implementation divides EveryTenMinutes by three, checks <5, and adds .05.
dimensions.positive_path: Starting counter=2, INTOXICATION=4, STRESS=.20 yields counter=3 and STRESS=.25.
dimensions.negative_path: At INTOXICATION=5 or counter result 1/2, STRESS is unchanged, rejecting <=5 and every-ten-minute interpretations.

dimensions.proof: EveryTenMinutes invokes handler(); nil player and absent trait return; owner modData counter increments; non-third calls return; third calls read INTOXICATION and conditionally set clamped STRESS.
dimensions.positive_path: Owner on a third callback while INTOXICATION<5 traverses getPlayer -> UTCore.hasTrait -> getModData -> getStats -> Stats.get/set.
dimensions.negative_path: Nil player, absent trait, non-third callback, or INTOXICATION>=5 cannot reach Stats.set.

dimensions.proof: Each owner callback writes counter=old+1. Only counter%3==0 and INTOXICATION<5 writes STRESS=min(1, old+.05). CharacterStat defines INTOXICATION 0..100 and STRESS 0..1; Stats.set clamps again to the stat range.
dimensions.positive_path: counter 2, INTOXICATION 4.999, STRESS .94 becomes counter 3, STRESS .99.
dimensions.negative_path: counter 2, INTOXICATION 5 leaves STRESS unchanged; qualifying STRESS .99 becomes 1, never 1.04.
dimensions.exact_missing_validation: No current in-game numeric observation verifies the Lua-to-float call and resulting displayed/engine stress value.

dimensions.proof: GameTime emits zero-argument EveryTenMinutes when now/10 changes; the trait registers exactly that event and divides its callbacks by three.
dimensions.positive_path: Three distinct producer boundaries advance the counter three times and allow one stat gate.
dimensions.negative_path: Ordinary minute boundaries and unrelated events do not invoke this handler.

dimensions.proof: There is no timestamp or cooldown field; modulo-3 over the ten-minute event is the only limiter.
dimensions.positive_path: The stat gate is reachable on counters 3, 6, 9, and so on.
dimensions.negative_path: No elapsed-real-time or world-age branch can delay or accelerate the gate independently of event delivery.

dimensions.proof: The only trait-owned state is player modData.UT_alcoholicI_ticks. IsoMovingObject saves and loads a non-empty Kahlua modData table, and IsoGameCharacter saves Stats. A saved counter=2 should therefore make the next owner callback qualifying; absent state starts from zero. A newly loaded player identity also invalidates production UTCore's per-player trait-result cache.
dimensions.positive_path: Round-trip counter=2 and Stats, recreate the player, then fire once and expect counter=3 and the conditional .05 write.
dimensions.negative_path: Round-trip empty modData or use a player without the trait: absent counter starts at zero, while trait absence returns before creating the key. Dynamic same-player trait removal is not normal vanilla behavior and would require UTCore.invalidateTraitCache to avoid a stale cached result.
dimensions.exact_missing_validation: No current in-game save/reload cycle demonstrates counter and Stats persistence followed by exactly one resumed handler invocation. Backward migration is intentionally out of scope.

dimensions.proof: The receiver chain is getPlayer()->IsoPlayer; production UTCore.hasTrait performs instanceof(IsoGameCharacter), ResourceLocation.of, CharacterTrait.get, then player:hasTrait(CharacterTrait); getModData returns the Kahlua table; getStats returns Stats; Stats.get(CharacterStat) and set(CharacterStat,float) receive INTOXICATION/STRESS. No Java collection indexing occurs.
dimensions.positive_path: Strict bridge objects accept the CharacterTrait receiver contract and Stats generic get/set with the two exact CharacterStat objects.
dimensions.negative_path: Nil player returns immediately. A mock that accepts a string directly in getTraits():contains can pass despite a broken production registry/receiver chain and is not sufficient bridge proof.
dimensions.exact_missing_validation: No live Kahlua invocation of the complete CharacterTrait and Stats receiver chain was observed.

dimensions.proof: The exact file uses basic Kahlua-compatible constructs only: locals, function/if/return, colon calls, table fields, or, arithmetic/modulo/comparison, math.min, and Events.Add. LuaManager loads mod shared files through RunLua once per distinct path during directory loading.
dimensions.positive_path: With UTCore, CharacterStat, math.min, getPlayer, and Events.EveryTenMinutes present, module evaluation supplies the local handler to Add.
dimensions.negative_path: Missing Events.EveryTenMinutes, UTCore, ResourceLocation/CharacterTrait, CharacterStat, or math.min is a hard dependency; only nil player and absent trait have explicit safe exits.
dimensions.exact_missing_validation: Static source and standard-Lua mocks do not prove current in-game Kahlua loading.

dimensions.proof: GameTime.updateCalendar emits EveryTenMinutes with zero payload arguments. Module evaluation calls Events.EveryTenMinutes.Add(handler); the file has no Remove or duplicate guard, so one module evaluation gives one persistent registration until Lua teardown.
dimensions.positive_path: Three producer boundaries invoke the zero-argument handler three times and the third reaches the sober gate.
dimensions.negative_path: Loading the physical file twice adds two registrations because the file itself has no idempotence guard; a cached/once-only loader lifecycle is therefore part of correctness.
dimensions.exact_missing_validation: No full exit/relaunch and repeated-world-entry trace confirms exactly one handler registration per active Lua process.

dimensions.proof: The owned definition excludes II and III; retained closed-world evidence proves reciprocal declarations. UT_MET.AlcoholDetox lists Iron Liver and all three alcohol tiers but is a lookup/grouping table, not parser enforcement. Forced coexistence would use independent counters/handlers and sequential additive STRESS writes, so exclusions—not shared state—prevent tier stacking.
dimensions.positive_path: Normal selection admits I without II/III; I coexists with unrelated traits and touches only its scalar counter and STRESS.
dimensions.negative_path: Force-injected tier coexistence can stack stat writes. UT_MET membership alone must not be credited as runtime removal or an Iron Liver suppression edge.
dimensions.exact_missing_validation: No in-game selection-order or forced-coexistence trace was run. Exhaustive all-trait gameplay stacking is not claimed.

dimensions.proof: DisabledInMultiplayer=true is present and parsed as restriction metadata.
dimensions.positive_path: The definition carries the intended single-player-only exclusion guard.
dimensions.negative_path: This metadata does not prove synchronization, server execution, or multiplayer safety.

dimensions.proof: UIName resolves to the present English value Alcoholic I.
dimensions.positive_path: UI_UT_alcoholic_I maps to the intended display name.
dimensions.negative_path: A missing or differently cased key would fail the join from the script definition.

dimensions.proof: English copy states INTOXICATION below 5, +0.05 STRESS, every 30 in-game minutes; all three claims match the exact conditional, amount, and event divisor.
dimensions.positive_path: The copy describes the qualifying third callback exactly.
dimensions.negative_path: It does not claim <=5, +5 percentage points without scale, or every ten minutes.

dimensions.proof: The selected English name and description keys exist and match runtime. The accepted closed-world ledger records that EN is the only locale and non-English locales are absent.
dimensions.positive_path: English lookup has complete key membership and semantically accurate copy.
dimensions.negative_path: English membership cannot establish any non-English fallback or translation coverage.
dimensions.exact_missing_validation: No non-English localization files exist; no in-game Translator rendering was observed even for EN.

dimensions.proof: Static mechanics are cost -4 for at most +.05 STRESS per 30 in-game minutes while INTOXICATION<5. Source provides no utility baseline, sober-time distribution, consumption availability, or acceptance threshold.
dimensions.positive_path: A controlled comparison would measure sober-time fraction, stress area-under-curve, alcohol consumption, and outcome delta against cost -4.
dimensions.negative_path: Static arithmetic or a unit assertion cannot establish player-value balance.
dimensions.exact_missing_validation: Controlled comparative gameplay telemetry with a declared acceptance threshold.

dimensions.proof: One O(1) callback per ten in-game minutes: nil/player trait checks; owner performs one scalar modData lookup/write and modulo; only one-third of owner callbacks reach Stats. This is 6 callbacks, 6 counter writes, and 2 stat gates per in-game hour, with one persistent scalar key and no loop or allocation growth.
dimensions.positive_path: For H in-game hours, callbacks=6H and stat gates=2H; memory remains one modData scalar.
dimensions.negative_path: Without the trait, production hasTrait caches the negative result and the handler returns before modData/Stats; there is no collection scan in this trait path.
dimensions.exact_missing_validation: No profiler capture was taken, so this is bounded static complexity proof rather than observed timing.

dimensions.proof: Two focused cases exist: eventual sober stress growth within nine EveryTenMinutes fires and suppression at INTOXICATION=10. Tests were intentionally not executed under this delegation.
dimensions.positive_path: The sober case reaches at least one modulo-3 gate and asserts STRESS>0.
dimensions.negative_path: The intoxicated case demonstrates no STRESS change at 10, but not the exact threshold or cadence boundaries.
dimensions.exact_missing_validation: Exact callback 1/2/3, +.05 amount, threshold=5, clamp, absent-trait, save/reload recreation, duplicate-load negative, and strict production receiver-chain fixtures; then the owning UniversalTraits suite command when separately authorized.

dimensions.proof: Mocks provide controllable CharacterStat objects with the correct ranges, generic Stats get/set, persistent player modData, getPlayer substitution, and an EveryTenMinutes handler list/fire surface. However mock Stats.set does not clamp, and mock UTCore.hasTrait bypasses the production ResourceLocation/CharacterTrait/instanceof/player:hasTrait receiver chain.
dimensions.positive_path: The mock can drive zero-argument event dispatch, scalar counter persistence within a player, and generic CharacterStat reads/writes.
dimensions.negative_path: A wrong string receiver contract or reliance on explicit math.min can pass; the mock will not independently enforce production Stats.set clamping or registry-backed trait lookup.
dimensions.exact_missing_validation: A strict integration-style mock/fixture must load production UTCore.hasTrait, enforce CharacterTrait receiver identity, and make Stats.set clamp via CharacterStat.clamp.

dimensions.proof: Exact SHA-256 pairs match for registries.lua, UT_character_traits.txt, EN/UI.json, UT_MET.lua, and UT_alcoholic_I.lua between source and release/UniversalTraits/42.0. mod.info also matches source, release root, and 42.0.
dimensions.positive_path: All trait-direct and shared owned copies are byte-identical at the current snapshot.
dimensions.negative_path: Parity does not make a missing referenced asset valid; identical mod.info files all reference the same absent poster.png.

dimensions.proof: The newest-only 42.0 package contains byte-matching trait/shared code and matching mod.info at source, package root, and 42.0. Each mod.info declares poster=poster.png, but the referenced poster is absent from all three levels checked.
dimensions.positive_path: The Lua/script/registry/UI and mod metadata copies are present and match exactly.
dimensions.negative_path: A package that references a missing poster asset is not structurally complete even when all text/code copies match.
dimensions.exact_missing_validation: No deploy/live verification is authorized. Product packaging remains defective until poster.png is supplied and parity-checked at the three declared locations.

validation_summary.note: The state subtotal intentionally counts the 23 substantive dimensions plus one non-goal; source_intent was upgraded from the generic ledger's runtime-unproven state because current exact comment/copy/implementation semantics were directly reconciled. No execution claim is inferred from that static semantic proof.
